newsitem.title: UK: British Aerospace shares down on stg worries.
newsitem.headline: British Aerospace shares down on stg worries.

text.p: British Aerospace shares extended recent losses on Wednesday on the back of fears that sterling's continued strength would hit profits, analysts said.
Shares in British Aerospace were down 27-1/2p at 11.98 stg by 1244 GMT, nearly matching Tuesday's fall of 28p.
"The sector is out of favour," SocGen analyst Zafar Kahn said. "All the big stocks that had done extremely well over the past year or so are being hammered by currency fears."
Sterling jumped more than four pfennings on Tuesday to come close to 52-month highs against the mark.
One analyst said profit taking ahead of British Aerospace results due on February 24 contributed to the fall.
